    s ×ˢ t₁ ○ t₂ ×ˢ u = ∅
proof:
:=
  Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun _ ⟨_z, ⟨_, hzs⟩, hzu, _⟩ ↦ Set.disjoint_left.1 ht hzs hzu

name: prod_comp_prod
statement:
lemma prod_comp_prod (s : Set α) (t₁ t₂ : Set β) (u : Set γ) [Decidable (Disjoint t₁ t₂)] :

proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with hst
  · exact prod_comp_prod_of_disjoint hst ..
  · rw [prod_comp_prod_of_inter_nonempty <| Set.not_disjoint_iff_nonempty_inter.1 hst]

lemma exists_eq_singleton_of_prod_subset_id {s t : Set α} (hs : s.Nonempty) (ht : t.Nonempty)
    (hst : s ×ˢ t ⊆ SetRel.id) : ∃ x, s = {x} ∧ t = {x}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ht
  simp only [Set.prod_subset_iff, mem_id] at hst
  obtain rfl := hst _ ha _ hb
  simp only [Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem, and_assoc]
  exact ⟨a, ha, (hst · · _ hb), hb, (hst _ ha · · |>.symm)⟩

lemma SetRel.exists_graph_eq_iff (R : SetRel α β) :
    (∃! f, Function.graph f = R) ↔ ∀ a, ∃! b, a ~[R] b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨f, rfl, _⟩ x
    simp
  intro h
  choose f hf using fun x ↦ (h x).exists
  refine ⟨f, ?_, by grind⟩
  ext ⟨a, b⟩
  constructor
  · grind
  · exact (h _).unique (hf _)

theorem ExistsUnique.elim₂ {p : α → Sort*} [∀ x, Subsingleton (p x)]
    {q : ∀ (x) (_ : p x), Prop} {b : Prop} (h₂ : ∃! x, ∃! h : p x, q x h)
    (h₁ : ∀ (x) (h : p x), q x h → (∀ (y) (hy : p y), q y hy → y = x) → b) : b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [existsUnique_iff_exists] at h₂
  apply h₂.elim
  exact fun x ⟨hxp, hxq⟩ H ↦ h₁ x hxp hxq fun y hyp hyq ↦ H y ⟨hyp, hyq⟩

  simp only [existsUnique_iff_exists]

name: exists_succ
statement: theorem exists_succ (x : s) : ∃ n, (x : ℕ) + n + 1 ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have (a : ℕ) (ha : a ∈ s) : a < x + 1 :=
    lt_of_not_ge fun hax => h ⟨a - (x + 1), by rwa [Nat.add_right_comm, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hax]⟩
  classical
  exact Fintype.false
    ⟨(((Multiset.range (succ x)).filter (· ∈ s)).pmap
      (fun (y : ℕ) (hy : y ∈ s) => Subtype.mk y hy) (by simp [-Multiset.range_succ])).toFinset,
      by simpa [Subtype.ext_iff, Multiset.mem_filter, -Multiset.range_succ] ⟩

name: succ_le_of_lt
statement: theorem succ_le_of_lt {x y : s} (h : y < x) : succ y ≤ x
proof:
:=
  have hx : ∃ m, (y : ℕ) + m + 1 ∈ s := exists_succ _
  let ⟨k, hk⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_lt h
  have : Nat.find hx ≤ k := Nat.find_min' _ (hk ▸ x.2)
  show (y : ℕ) + Nat.find hx + 1 ≤ x by lia

name: le_succ_of_forall_lt_le
statement: theorem le_succ_of_forall_lt_le {x y : s} (h : ∀ z < x, z ≤ y) : x ≤ succ y
proof:
:=
  have hx : ∃ m, (y : ℕ) + m + 1 ∈ s := exists_succ _
  show (x : ℕ) ≤ (y : ℕ) + Nat.find hx + 1 from
    le_of_not_gt fun hxy =>
      (h ⟨_, Nat.find_spec hx⟩ hxy).not_gt <|
        (by lia : (y : ℕ) < (y : ℕ) + Nat.find hx + 1)

proof:
:=

    lt_of_le_of_lt h (lt_succ_self _)⟩

name: ofNat_surjective
statement:
theorem ofNat_surjective : Surjective (ofNat s)
  | ⟨x, hx⟩ => by
    set t : List s
proof:
:=
      ((List.range x).filter fun y => y ∈ s).pmap
        (fun (y : ℕ) (hy : y ∈ s) => ⟨y, hy⟩)
        (by intro a ha; simpa using! (List.mem_filter.mp ha).2) with ht
    have hmt : ∀ {y : s}, y ∈ t ↔ y < ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
      simp [List.mem_filter, Subtype.ext_iff, ht]
    cases hmax : List.maximum t with
    | bot =>
      refine ⟨0, le_antisymm bot_le (le_of_not_gt fun h => List.not_mem_nil (a := (⊥ : s)) ?_)⟩
      rwa [← List.maximum_eq_bot.1 hmax, hmt]
    | coe m =>
      have wf : ↑m < x := by simpa using! hmt.mp (List.maximum_mem hmax)
      rcases ofNat_surjective m with ⟨a, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨a + 1, le_antisymm (succ_le_of_lt wf) ?_⟩
      exact le_succ_of_forall_lt_le fun z hz => List.le_maximum_of_mem (hmt.2 hz) hmax
  termination_by n => n.val

name: toFunAux_eq
statement:
private theorem toFunAux_eq {s : Set ℕ} [DecidablePred (· ∈ s)] (x : s) :
    toFunAux x = #{y ∈ Finset.range x | y ∈ s}

name: right_inverse_aux
statement:
private theorem right_inverse_aux : ∀ n, toFunAux (ofNat s n) = n
  | 0 => by
    rw [toFunAux_eq, card_eq_zero, eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
    rintro n hn
    rw [mem_filter, ofNat, mem_range] at hn
    exact bot_le.not_gt (show (⟨n, hn.2⟩ : s) < ⊥ from hn.1)
  | n + 1 => by
    have ih : toFunAux (ofNat s n) = n
proof:
:= right_inverse_aux n
    have h₁ : (ofNat s n : ℕ) ∉ {x ∈ range (ofNat s n) | x ∈ s} := by simp
    have h₂ : {x ∈ range (succ (ofNat s n)) | x ∈ s} =
        insert ↑(ofNat s n) {x ∈ range (ofNat s n) | x ∈ s} := by
      simp only [Finset.ext_iff, mem_insert, mem_range, mem_filter]
      exact fun m =>
        ⟨fun h => by
          simp only [h.2, and_true]
          exact Or.symm (lt_or_eq_of_le ((@lt_succ_iff_le _ _ _ ⟨m, h.2⟩ _).1 h.1)),
         fun h =>
          h.elim (fun h => h.symm ▸ ⟨lt_succ_self _, (ofNat s n).prop⟩) fun h =>
            ⟨h.1.trans (lt_succ_self _), h.2⟩⟩
    simp only [toFunAux_eq, ofNat] at ih ⊢
    conv =>
      rhs
      rw [← ih, ← card_insert_of_notMem h₁, ← h₂]

:=
  let ⟨x, y, h⟩ := exists_pair_ne α
  ⟨⟨f x, f y, hf.ne h⟩⟩

name: Function.Injective.exists_ne
statement:
protected theorem Function.Injective.exists_ne [Nontrivial α] {f : α → β}
    (hf : Function.Injective f) (y : β) : ∃ x, f x ≠ y
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_pair_ne α with ⟨x₁, x₂, hx⟩
  by_cases h : f x₂ = y
  · exact ⟨x₁, (hf.ne_iff' h).2 hx⟩
  · exact ⟨x₂, h⟩

name: Decidable.exists_ne
statement: protected theorem Decidable.exists_ne [Nontrivial α] [DecidableEq α] (x : α) : ∃ y, y ≠ x
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_pair_ne α with ⟨y, y', h⟩
  by_cases hx : x = y
  · rw [← hx] at h
    exact ⟨y', h.symm⟩
  · exact ⟨y, Ne.symm hx⟩

statement: theorem nontrivial_iff_exists_ne (x : α) : Nontrivial α ↔ ∃ y, y ≠ x
proof:
:=

name: Function.nontrivial_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem Function.nontrivial_of_nontrivial (α β : Type*) [Nontrivial (α → β)] :
    Nontrivial β
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, g, h⟩ := exists_pair_ne (α → β)
  rw [ne_eq, funext_iff, Classical.not_forall] at h
  obtain ⟨a, h⟩ := h
  exact nontrivial_of_ne _ _ h

statement: theorem subsingleton_or_nontrivial (α : Type*) : Subsingleton α ∨ Nontrivial α
proof:

name: Function.Surjective.nontrivial
statement:
protected theorem Function.Surjective.nontrivial [Nontrivial β] {f : α → β}
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) : Nontrivial α
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_pair_ne β with ⟨x, y, h⟩
  rcases hf x with ⟨x', hx'⟩
  rcases hf y with ⟨y', hy'⟩
  have : x' ≠ y' := by
    refine fun H ↦ h ?_
    rw [← hx', ← hy', H]
  exact ⟨⟨x', y', this⟩⟩

proof:

  Iff.intro
    (fun ⟨b, hb⟩ =>
      ⟨Real.toNNReal b, fun ⟨y, _⟩ hys =>
        show y ≤ max b 0 from le_max_of_le_left <| hb <| Set.mem_image_of_mem _ hys⟩)

name: coe_sSup
statement:
@[norm_cast]
theorem coe_sSup (s : Set ℝ≥0) : (↑(sSup s) : ℝ) = sSup (((↑) : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) '' s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Set.eq_empty_or_nonempty s with rfl | hs
  · simp
  by_cases H : BddAbove s
  · have A : sSup (Subtype.val '' s) ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by
      apply Real.sSup_nonneg
      rintro - ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
      exact y.2
    exact (@subset_sSup_of_within ℝ (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) _ _ (_) s hs H A).symm
  · simp only [csSup_of_not_bddAbove H, csSup_empty, bot_eq_zero', NNReal.coe_zero]
    apply (Real.sSup_of_not_bddAbove ?_).symm
    contrapose H
    exact bddAbove_coe.1 H

  · simp only [Set.image_empty, Real.sInf_empty, coe_eq_zero]

  have A : sInf (Subtype.val '' s) ∈ Set.Ici 0 := by
    apply Real.sInf_nonneg
    rintro - ⟨y, -, rfl⟩
    exact y.2
  exact (@subset_sInf_of_within ℝ (Set.Ici (0 : ℝ)) _ _ (_) s hs (OrderBot.bddBelow s) A).symm

name: lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn

    a < b ↔ ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ q ∧ a < Real.toNNReal q ∧ Real.toNNReal q < b
proof:
:=
  Iff.intro
    (fun h : (↑a : ℝ) < (↑b : ℝ) =>
      let ⟨q, haq, hqb⟩ := exists_rat_btwn h
      have : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := le_trans a.2 <| le_of_lt haq
      ⟨q, Rat.cast_nonneg.1 this, by
        simp [Real.coe_toNNReal _ this, NNReal.coe_lt_coe.symm, haq, hqb]⟩)
    fun ⟨_, _, haq, hqb⟩ => lt_trans haq hqb

statement: lemma nnreal_dichotomy (r : ℝ) : ∃ x : ℝ≥0, r = x ∨ r = -x
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hr | hr) : 0 ≤ r ∨ 0 ≤ -r := by simpa using le_total ..
  all_goals
    rw [← neg_neg r]
    lift (_ : ℝ) to ℝ≥0 using hr with r
    aesop

  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := nnreal_dichotomy r
  rw [or_iff_not_imp_left]
  aesop (add simp pos_iff_ne_zero)

name: NNReal.exists_lt_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem NNReal.exists_lt_of_strictMono [h : Nontrivial Γ₀ˣ] {f : Γ₀ →*₀ ℝ≥0} (hf : StrictMono f)
    {r : ℝ≥0} (hr : 0 < r) : ∃ d : Γ₀ˣ, f d < r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg1⟩ := (nontrivial_iff_exists_ne (1 : Γ₀ˣ)).mp h
  set u : Γ₀ˣ := if g < 1 then g else g⁻¹ with hu
  have hfu : f u < 1 := by
    rw [hu]
    split_ifs with hu1
    · rw [← map_one f]; exact hf hu1
    · have hfg0 : f g ≠ 0 :=
        fun h0 ↦ (Units.ne_zero g) ((map_eq_zero f).mp h0)
      have hg1' : 1 < g := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hu1) hg1.symm
      rw [Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, map_inv₀, inv_lt_one_iff hfg0, ← map_one f]
      exact hf hg1'
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_lt_of_lt_one hr hfu
  use u ^ n
  rwa [Units.val_pow_eq_pow_val, map_pow]

name: Real.exists_lt_of_strictMono
statement:
theorem Real.exists_lt_of_strictMono [h : Nontrivial Γ₀ˣ] {f : Γ₀ →*₀ ℝ≥0} (hf : StrictMono f)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) : ∃ d : Γ₀ˣ, (f d : ℝ) < r
proof:
:= by
  set s : NNReal := ⟨r, le_of_lt hr⟩
  have hs : 0 < s := hr
  exact NNReal.exists_lt_of_strictMono hf hs

name: horizontalSegment_eq
statement:
lemma horizontalSegment_eq (a₁ a₂ b : ℝ) :
    (fun (x : ℝ) ↦ x + b * I) '' [[a₁, a₂]] = [[a₁, a₂]] ×ℂ {b}
proof:
:= by
  rw [← preimage_equivRealProd_prod]
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hx₁'⟩ := hx
    simp [← hx₁', mem_preimage, mem_prod, hx₁]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hx₁', hx₁''⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨x.re, x₁, by simp⟩

statement:

    (fun (y : ℝ) ↦ a + y * I) '' [[b₁, b₂]] = {a} ×ℂ [[b₁, b₂]]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← preimage_equivRealProd_prod]
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hx₁'⟩ := hx
    simp [← hx₁', mem_preimage, mem_prod, hx₁]
  · intro hx
    simp only [equivRealProd_apply, singleton_prod, mem_image, Prod.mk.injEq,
      exists_eq_right_right, mem_preimage] at hx
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hx₁', hx₁''⟩ := hx
    refine ⟨x.im, x₁, by simp⟩

name: sign_apply_eq
statement: theorem sign_apply_eq (r : ℝ) : sign r = -1 ∨ sign r = 0 ∨ sign r = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain hn | rfl | hp := lt_trichotomy r (0 : ℝ)
  · exact Or.inl <| sign_of_neg hn
  · exact Or.inr <| Or.inl <| sign_zero
  · exact Or.inr <| Or.inr <| sign_of_pos hp

name: sign_apply_eq_of_ne_zero

name: sign_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sign_eq_zero_iff {r : ℝ} : sign r = 0 ↔ r = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.symm ▸ sign_zero⟩
  obtain hn | rfl | hp := lt_trichotomy r (0 : ℝ)
  · rw [sign_of_neg hn, neg_eq_zero] at h
    exact (one_ne_zero h).elim
  · rfl
  · rw [sign_of_pos hp] at h
    exact (one_ne_zero h).elim

name: sign_intCast

proof:
:= by
  obtain hn | rfl | hp := lt_trichotomy z (0 : ℤ)
  · rw [sign_of_neg (Int.cast_lt_zero.mpr hn), Int.sign_eq_neg_one_of_neg hn, Int.cast_neg,
      Int.cast_one]
  · rw [Int.cast_zero, sign_zero, Int.sign_zero, Int.cast_zero]
  · rw [sign_of_pos (Int.cast_pos.mpr hp), Int.sign_eq_one_of_pos hp, Int.cast_one]

name: sign_neg
statement: theorem sign_neg {r : ℝ} : sign (-r) = -sign r
proof:
:= by
  obtain hn | rfl | hp := lt_trichotomy r (0 : ℝ)
  · rw [sign_of_neg hn, sign_of_pos (neg_pos.mpr hn), neg_neg]
  · rw [sign_zero, neg_zero, sign_zero]
  · rw [sign_of_pos hp, sign_of_neg (neg_lt_zero.mpr hp)]

name: sign_mul_nonneg
statement: theorem sign_mul_nonneg (r : ℝ) : 0 ≤ sign r * r
proof:
:= by
  obtain hn | rfl | hp := lt_trichotomy r (0 : ℝ)
  · rw [sign_of_neg hn]
    exact mul_nonneg_of_nonpos_of_nonpos (by simp) hn.le
  · rw [mul_zero]
  · rw [sign_of_pos hp, one_mul]
    exact hp.le

name: sign_mul_pos_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem sign_mul_pos_of_ne_zero (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) : 0 < sign r * r
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne (sign_mul_nonneg r) fun h => hr ?_
  have hs0 := (zero_eq_mul.mp h).resolve_right hr
  exact sign_eq_zero_iff.mp hs0

name: inv_sign
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_sign (r : ℝ) : (sign r)⁻¹ = sign r
proof:
:= by
  obtain hn | hz | hp := sign_apply_eq r
  · rw [hn]
    simp
  · rw [hz]
    exact inv_zero
  · rw [hp]
    exact inv_one

name: sign_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sign_inv (r : ℝ) : sign r⁻¹ = sign r
proof:
:= by
  obtain hn | rfl | hp := lt_trichotomy r (0 : ℝ)
  · rw [sign_of_neg hn, sign_of_neg (inv_lt_zero.mpr hn)]
  · rw [sign_zero, inv_zero, sign_zero]
  · rw [sign_of_pos hp, sign_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hp)]

statement: theorem Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg (ha : 0 ≤ a) (s : Set ℝ) : sInf (a • s) = a • sInf s
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hs := s.eq_empty_or_nonempty
  · rw [smul_set_empty, Real.sInf_empty, smul_zero]
  obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt
  · rw [zero_smul_set hs, zero_smul]
    exact csInf_singleton 0
  by_cases h : BddBelow s
  · exact ((OrderIso.smulRight ha').map_csInf' hs h).symm
  · rw [Real.sInf_of_not_bddBelow (mt (bddBelow_smul_iff_of_pos ha').1 h),
        Real.sInf_of_not_bddBelow h, smul_zero]

  · rw [smul_set_empty, Real.sSup_empty, Real.sInf_empty, smul_zero]
  obtain rfl | ha' := ha.eq_or_lt

  · rw [Real.sSup_of_not_bddAbove (mt (bddAbove_smul_iff_of_neg ha').1 h),

  · rw [NNReal.holderTriple_iff]

      constructor
      all_goals

        apply hr

    exact ⟨by exact_mod_cast h.inv_add_inv_eq_inv, hp.bot_lt, hq.bot_lt⟩
  · rw [holderTriple_iff]

name: conjExponent
statement: protected lemma conjExponent {p : ℝ≥0∞} (hp : 1 ≤ p) : p.HolderConjugate (conjExponent p)
proof:
:= by
  have : p ≠ 0 := (zero_lt_one.trans_le hp).ne'
  rw [HolderConjugate, holderTriple_iff, conjExponent, add_comm]
  refine (AddLECancellable.eq_tsub_iff_add_eq_of_le (α := ℝ≥0∞) (by simpa) (by simpa)).1 ?_
  rw [inv_eq_iff_eq_inv]
  obtain rfl | hp₁ := hp.eq_or_lt
  · simp
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p ∞
  · simp
  calc
    1 + (p - 1)⁻¹ = (p - 1 + 1) / (p - 1) := by
      rw [ENNReal.add_div, ENNReal.div_self ((tsub_pos_of_lt hp₁).ne') (sub_ne_top hp), one_div]
    _ = (1⁻¹ - p⁻¹)⁻¹ := by
      rw [tsub_add_cancel_of_le, ← inv_eq_iff_eq_inv, div_eq_mul_inv, ENNReal.mul_inv, inv_inv,
        ENNReal.mul_sub, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel, mul_one] <;> simp [*]

name: conjExponent_eq

:=
  have : Fact (1 ≤ p) := ⟨one_le p q⟩
  unique p (conjExponent p) q

name: mul_eq_add
statement: lemma mul_eq_add : p * q = p + q
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hp := eq_or_ne p ∞
  · simp [ne_zero q ∞]
  obtain rfl | hq := eq_or_ne q ∞
  · simp [ne_zero p ∞]
  simpa [add_comm p, mul_add, add_mul, hp, hq, ne_zero p q, ne_zero q p, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel,
    ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel_right] using congr(p * $((inv_add_inv_eq_one p q).symm) * q)

name: div_conj_eq_sub_one
statement: lemma div_conj_eq_sub_one : p / q = p - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hq := eq_or_ne q ∞
  · obtain rfl := unique ∞ p 1
    simp
  refine ENNReal.eq_sub_of_add_eq one_ne_top ?_
  rw [← ENNReal.div_self (ne_zero q p) hq, ← ENNReal.add_div, ← h.mul_eq_add, mul_div_assoc,
    ENNReal.div_self (ne_zero q p) hq, mul_one]

name: le_mk_of_forall_le
statement: theorem le_mk_of_forall_le {f : CauSeq ℚ abs} : (∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, x ≤ f j) → x ≤ mk f
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  induction x using Real.ind_mk
  apply le_of_not_gt
  rw [mk_lt]
  rintro ⟨K, K0, hK⟩
  obtain ⟨i, H⟩ := exists_forall_ge_and h (exists_forall_ge_and hK (f.cauchy₃ <| half_pos K0))
  apply not_lt_of_ge (H _ le_rfl).1
  rw [← mk_const, mk_lt]
  refine ⟨_, half_pos K0, i, fun j ij => ?_⟩
  have := add_le_add (H _ ij).2.1 (le_of_lt (abs_lt.1 <| (H _ le_rfl).2.2 _ ij).1)
  rwa [← sub_eq_add_neg, sub_self_div_two, sub_apply, sub_add_sub_cancel] at this

name: mk_le_of_forall_le
statement:
theorem mk_le_of_forall_le {f : CauSeq ℚ abs} {x : ℝ} (h : ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, (f j : ℝ) ≤ x) :
    mk f ≤ x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, H⟩ := h
  rw [← neg_le_neg_iff, ← mk_neg]
  exact le_mk_of_forall_le ⟨i, fun j ij => by simp [H _ ij]⟩

name: mk_near_of_forall_near
statement:
theorem mk_near_of_forall_near {f : CauSeq ℚ abs} {x : ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (H : ∃ i, ∀ j ≥ i, |(f j : ℝ) - x| ≤ ε) : |mk f - x| ≤ ε
proof:
:=
  abs_sub_le_iff.2
    ⟨sub_le_iff_le_add'.2 <|
        mk_le_of_forall_le <|
          H.imp fun _ h j ij => sub_le_iff_le_add'.1 (abs_sub_le_iff.1 <| h j ij).1,
      sub_le_comm.1 <|
        le_mk_of_forall_le <| H.imp fun _ h j ij => sub_le_comm.1 (abs_sub_le_iff.1 <| h j ij).2⟩

name: mul_add_one_le_add_one_pow
statement: lemma mul_add_one_le_add_one_pow {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (b : ℕ) : a * b + 1 ≤ (a + 1) ^ b
proof:
:= by
  rcases ha.eq_or_lt with rfl | ha'
  · simp
  clear ha
  induction b generalizing a with
  | zero => simp
  | succ b hb =>
    calc
      a * ↑(b + 1) + 1 = (0 + 1) ^ b * a + (a * b + 1) := by
        simp [mul_add, add_assoc, add_left_comm]
      _ ≤ (a + 1) ^ b * a + (a + 1) ^ b := by
        gcongr
        · norm_num
        · exact hb ha'
      _ = (a + 1) ^ (b + 1) := by simp [pow_succ, mul_add]

name: IsPowMul.map_one_le_one
statement:
lemma IsPowMul.map_one_le_one {R : Type*} [Monoid R] {f : R → ℝ} (hf : IsPowMul f) :

proof:
:= by
  have hf1 : (f 1) ^ 2 = f 1 := by conv_rhs => rw [← one_pow 2, hf _ one_le_two]
  rcases eq_zero_or_one_of_sq_eq_self hf1 with h | h <;> rw [h]
  exact zero_le_one

name: mul_smul_one_lt_iff
statement:
theorem mul_smul_one_lt_iff {num : ℤ} {n den : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) {x : M} :
    (num * n) • 1 < (n * den : ℤ) • x ↔ num • 1 < den • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm num, mul_smul, mul_smul, natCast_zsmul x den]
  exact ⟨fun h ↦ lt_of_smul_lt_smul_left h (Int.natCast_nonneg n),
    fun h ↦ zsmul_lt_zsmul_right (Int.natCast_pos.mpr hn) h⟩

name: num_smul_one_lt_den_smul_add
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : (u.num * v.den) • 1 < (u.den * v.den : ℤ) • x := by
    simpa [mul_comm] using (mul_smul_one_lt_iff v.den_pos).mpr hu
  suffices ((u + v).num * u.den * v.den) • 1 <
      ((u + v).den : ℤ) • (u.den * v.den : ℤ) • (x + y) by
    refine (mul_smul_one_lt_iff (mul_pos u.den_pos v.den_pos)).mp ?_
    rwa [Nat.cast_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm _ ((u + v).den : ℤ), ← smul_eq_mul ((u + v).den : ℤ),
      smul_assoc]
  rw [Rat.add_num_den', mul_comm, ← smul_smul]
  rw [smul_lt_smul_iff_of_pos_left (by simpa using (u + v).den_pos)]
  rw [add_smul, smul_add]
  exact add_lt_add hu' ((mul_smul_one_lt_iff u.den_pos).mpr hv)

name: num_le_nat_mul_den
statement:
theorem num_le_nat_mul_den [ZeroLEOneClass M] [NeZero (1 : M)]
    {num : ℤ} {den : ℕ} {x : M} (h : num • 1 ≤ den • x)
    {n : ℤ} (hn : x ≤ n • 1) : num ≤ n * den
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_smul_le_smul_right (h.trans ?_) (by simp)
  rw [mul_comm, ← smul_smul]
  simpa using nsmul_le_nsmul_right hn den

name: mkRat_mem_ratLt
statement:
theorem mkRat_mem_ratLt {num : ℤ} {den : ℕ} (hden : den ≠ 0) {x : M} :
    mkRat num den ∈ ratLt x ↔ num • 1 < den • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.mem_ofPred]
  obtain ⟨m, hm0, hnum, hden⟩ := Rat.mkRat_num_den hden (show mkRat num den = _ by rfl)
  conv in num • 1 => rw [hnum, mul_comm, ← smul_smul, natCast_zsmul]
  conv in den • x => rw [hden, mul_comm, ← smul_smul]
  exact (smul_lt_smul_iff_of_pos_left (Nat.zero_lt_of_ne_zero hm0)).symm

name: ratLt_bddAbove
statement: theorem ratLt_bddAbove (x : M) : BddAbove (ratLt x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Archimedean.arch x zero_lt_one
  use n
  rw [ratLt, mem_upperBounds]
  intro ⟨num, den, _, _⟩
  rw [Rat.le_iff]
  suffices num • 1 < den • x → num ≤ n * den by simpa using this
  intro h
  exact num_le_nat_mul_den h.le (by simpa using hn)

name: ratLt_nonempty
statement: theorem ratLt_nonempty (x : M) : (ratLt x).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain hneg | rfl | hxpos := lt_trichotomy x 0
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Archimedean.arch (-x - x) zero_lt_one
    use Rat.ofInt (-n)
    suffices -(n • 1) < x by simpa using this
    exact neg_lt.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (by simpa using hneg) hn)
  · exact ⟨Rat.ofInt (-1), by simp⟩
  · obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Archimedean.arch 1 hxpos
    use Rat.mk' 1 (n + 1) (by simp) (by simp)
    simpa using hn.trans_lt <| (nsmul_lt_nsmul_iff_left hxpos).mpr (by simp)

name: ratLt_add
statement: theorem ratLt_add (x y : M) : ratLt (x + y) = ratLt x + ratLt y
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [Set.mem_add]
  constructor
  · /- Given `a ∈ ratLt 1 (x + y)`, find `u ∈ ratLt 1 x`, `v ∈ ratLt 1 y`
      such that `u + v = a`.
      In a naive attempt, one can take the denominator `d` of `a`,
      and find the largest `u = p / d < x / 1`.
      However, `d` could be too "coarse", and `v = a - u` could be 1/d too large than `y / 1`.
      To ensure a large enough denominator, we take `d * k`, where
      `1 + 1 ≤ k • (d • (x + y) - a.num • 1)`. -/
    intro h
    rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at h
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Archimedean.arch (1 + 1) <| sub_pos.mpr h
    have hk0 : k ≠ 0 := by
      contrapose! hk
      simp [hk]
    have hka0 : k * a.den ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hk0 a.den_ne_zero
    obtain ⟨m, ⟨hm1, hm2⟩, _⟩ := existsUnique_add_zsmul_mem_Ico zero_lt_one 0 (k • a.den • x - 1)
    refine ⟨mkRat m (k * a.den), ?_, mkRat (k * a.num - m) (k * a.den), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [mkRat_mem_ratLt hka0, ← smul_smul]
      simpa using hm2
    · have hk' : 1 + (k • a.num • 1 - k • a.den • y) ≤ k • a.den • x - 1 := by
        rw [smul_add, smul_sub, smul_add, le_sub_iff_add_le, ← sub_le_iff_le_add] at hk
        rw [le_sub_iff_add_le]
        convert! hk using 1
        abel
      have : k • a.num • 1 - k • a.den • y < m • 1 :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_add_of_pos_left _ zero_lt_one) (by simpa using hk'.trans hm1)
      rw [mkRat_mem_ratLt hka0, sub_smul, sub_lt_comm, ← smul_smul, ← smul_smul, natCast_zsmul]
      exact this
    · rw [Rat.mkRat_add_mkRat_of_den _ _ hka0]
      rw [add_sub_cancel, Rat.mkRat_mul_left hk0, Rat.mkRat_num_den']
  · 
    intro ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩
    rw [← huv]
    rw [Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hu hv ⊢
    exact num_smul_one_lt_den_smul_add hu hv

name: embedRealFun_zero
statement: theorem embedRealFun_zero : embedRealFun (0 : M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply csSup_le (ratLt'_nonempty 0)
    intro x
    unfold ratLt' ratLt
    suffices ∀ (y : ℚ), y.num • (1 : M) < 0 → y = x → x ≤ 0 by simpa using this
    intro y hy hyx
    rw [← hyx, Rat.cast_nonpos, ← Rat.num_nonpos]
    exact (neg_of_smul_neg_right hy zero_le_one).le
  · rw [le_csSup_iff (ratLt'_bddAbove (0 : M)) (ratLt'_nonempty 0)]
    intro x
    rw [mem_upperBounds]
    suffices (∀ (y : ℚ), y.num • (1 : M) < 0 → y ≤ x) → 0 ≤ x by simpa using this
    intro h
    have h' (y : ℚ) (hy : y < 0) : y ≤ x := by
      exact h _ <| (smul_neg_iff_of_neg_left (by simpa using hy)).mpr zero_lt_one
    contrapose! h'
    obtain ⟨y, hxy, hy⟩ := exists_rat_btwn h'
    exact ⟨y, by simpa using hy, hxy⟩

name: embedRealFun_add
statement: theorem embedRealFun_add (x y : M) : embedRealFun (x + y) = embedRealFun x + embedRealFun y
proof:
:= by
  rw [embedRealFun, ratLt'_add, csSup_add (ratLt'_nonempty x) (ratLt'_bddAbove x)
    (ratLt'_nonempty y) (ratLt'_bddAbove y)]

name: embedRealFun_strictMono
statement: theorem embedRealFun_strictMono : StrictMono (embedRealFun (M := M))
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have hyz : 0 < y - x := sub_pos.mpr h
  have hy : y = y - x + x := (sub_add_cancel y x).symm
  apply lt_of_sub_pos
  rw [hy, embedRealFun_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Archimedean.arch 1 hyz
  have : (Rat.mk' 1 (n + 1) (by simp) (by simp) : ℝ) ∈ ratLt' (y - x) := by
    simpa using hn.trans_lt <| nsmul_lt_nsmul_left hyz (show n < n + 1 by simp)
  exact lt_csSup_of_lt (ratLt'_bddAbove (y - x)) this (by simp [← Rat.num_pos])

name: embedReal_apply

name: embedReal_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem embedReal_one : (embedReal M) 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [embedReal_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply csSup_le (ratLt'_nonempty 1)
    suffices ∀ (x : ℚ), x.num • (1 : M) < (x.den : ℤ) • (1 : M) → (x : ℝ) ≤ 1 by simpa using this
    intro x hx
    suffices x ≤ 1 by norm_cast
    simpa [Rat.le_iff] using ((smul_lt_smul_iff_of_pos_right zero_lt_one).mp hx).le
  · rw [le_csSup_iff (ratLt'_bddAbove (1 : M)) (ratLt'_nonempty 1)]
    simp_rw [mem_upperBounds]
    suffices ∀ (x : ℝ), (∀ (y : ℚ), y.num • (1 : M) < (y.den : ℤ) • 1 → y ≤ x) → 1 ≤ x by
      simpa using this
    intro x h
    have h' (y : ℚ) (hy : y < 1) : y ≤ x :=
      h _ ((smul_lt_smul_iff_of_pos_right zero_lt_one).mpr (by simpa using (Rat.lt_iff _ _).mp hy))
    contrapose! h'
    obtain ⟨y, hxy, hy⟩ := exists_rat_btwn h'
    exact ⟨y, (by norm_cast at hy), hxy⟩

name: exists_orderAddMonoidHom_real_injective
statement:
theorem exists_orderAddMonoidHom_real_injective :
    ∃ f : M →+o ℝ, Function.Injective f
proof:
:= by
  cases subsingleton_or_nontrivial M
  · exact ⟨0, Function.injective_of_subsingleton _⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := exists_ne (0 : M)
    let one : One M := ⟨|a|⟩
    have : ZeroLEOneClass M := ⟨abs_nonneg a⟩
    have : NeZero (1 : M) := ⟨abs_ne_zero.mpr ha⟩
    exact ⟨embedReal M, embedReal_injective M⟩

statement:
lemma Finite.sigma {s : Set α} {t : ∀ i, Set (β i)} (hs : s.Finite) (ht : ∀ i ∈ s, (t i).Finite) :
    (s.sigma t).Finite
proof:
:= by
  have := hs.to_subtype
  have : ∀ i : s, Finite (t i) := fun i ↦ (ht i i.2).to_subtype
  exact (Set.univ.sigma fun i : s ↦ t i).toFinite.of_equiv _ {
    toFun := fun x ↦ ⟨⟨x.1.1, x.1.2⟩, ⟨x.1.1.2, x.2.2⟩⟩
    invFun := fun x ↦ ⟨⟨⟨x.1.1, x.2.1⟩, x.1.2⟩, ⟨Set.mem_univ _, x.2.2⟩⟩
  }

protected theorem infinite_prod :
    (s ×ˢ t).Infinite ↔ s.Infinite ∧ t.Nonempty ∨ t.Infinite ∧ s.Nonempty

:= by

  · simp_rw [Set.Infinite, @and_comm ¬_, ← Classical.not_imp]
    by_contra!
    exact h ((this.1 h.nonempty.snd).prod <| this.2 h.nonempty.fst)

    · exact h.1.prod_right h.2

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => Set.infinite_prod.1 ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← image_uncurry_prod] at h
    exact h.of_image _
  · rintro (⟨hs, b, hb⟩ | ⟨ht, a, ha⟩)
    · exact hs.image2_left hb (hfs _ hb)
    · exact ht.image2_right ha (hft _ ha)

  grind only [Set.Infinite.nonempty]

proof:
:= by
  rintro x hx
  by_contra! h
  simpa [U.rfl] using h _ <| hN.2 (y := insert x N) ⟨by simp [insert_subset_iff, hx, hN.1.1],

:= by
  apply ENNReal.sub_eq_of_eq_add (ne_of_lt ?_) (inv_eq p q r)
  calc
    q⁻¹ ≤ r⁻¹ := HolderTriple.inv_le_inv q p r
    _ < ∞ := by simpa using pos_iff_ne_zero.mpr hr

name: inv_sub_inv_eq_inv'

proof:
:= by
  obtain (rfl | hr) := eq_zero_or_pos r
  · suffices p = 0 by simpa [this]
    by_contra! hp
    have := calc
      0⁻¹ = p⁻¹ + q⁻¹ := inv_eq p q 0
      _ < ⊤ + ⊤ := by simp [hp, hq, pos_iff_ne_zero]
      _ = ⊤ := by simp
    simp_all
  · exact inv_sub_inv_eq_inv p q hr.ne'

statement:
theorem lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn :
    a < b ↔ ∃ q : ℚ, 0 ≤ q ∧ a < Real.toNNReal q ∧ (Real.toNNReal q : ℝ≥0∞) < b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rcases lt_iff_exists_coe.1 h with ⟨p, rfl, _⟩
    rcases exists_between h with ⟨c, pc, cb⟩
    rcases lt_iff_exists_coe.1 cb with ⟨r, rfl, _⟩
    rcases (NNReal.lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn _ _).1 (coe_lt_coe.1 pc) with ⟨q, hq0, pq, qr⟩
    exact ⟨q, hq0, coe_lt_coe.2 pq, lt_trans (coe_lt_coe.2 qr) cb⟩,
      fun ⟨_, _, qa, qb⟩ => lt_trans qa qb⟩

    a < b ↔ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r ∧ a < ENNReal.ofReal r ∧ (ENNReal.ofReal r : ℝ≥0∞) < b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h =>
    let ⟨q, q0, aq, qb⟩ := ENNReal.lt_iff_exists_rat_btwn.1 h
    ⟨q, Rat.cast_nonneg.2 q0, aq, qb⟩,
    fun ⟨_, _, qa, qb⟩ => lt_trans qa qb⟩

name: lt_iff_exists_add_pos_lt
statement: theorem lt_iff_exists_add_pos_lt : a < b ↔ ∃ r : ℝ≥0, 0 < r ∧ a + r < b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hab => ?_, fun ⟨r, _, hr⟩ => lt_of_le_of_lt le_self_add hr⟩
  rcases lt_iff_exists_nnreal_btwn.1 hab with ⟨c, ac, cb⟩
  lift a to ℝ≥0 using ac.ne_top
  rw [coe_lt_coe] at ac
  refine ⟨c - a, tsub_pos_iff_lt.2 ac, ?_⟩
  rwa [← coe_add, add_tsub_cancel_of_le ac.le]

statement:
theorem le_of_top_imp_top_of_toNNReal_le {a b : ℝ≥0∞} (h : a = ⊤ → b = ⊤)
    (h_nnreal : a ≠ ⊤ → b ≠ ⊤ → a.toNNReal ≤ b.toNNReal) : a ≤ b

:= by

  · rw [ofReal_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos_of_le h), tsub_eq_zero_of_le (ofReal_le_ofReal h)]
  refine ENNReal.eq_sub_of_add_eq ofReal_ne_top ?_
  rw [← ofReal_add (sub_nonneg_of_le h) hq, sub_add_cancel]

name: sub_sub_sub_cancel_left
statement: lemma sub_sub_sub_cancel_left (ha : a ≠ ∞) (h : b ≤ a) : a - c - (a - b) = b - c
proof:
:= by
  have hb : b ≠ ∞ := ne_top_of_le_ne_top ha h
  lift a to ℝ≥0 using ha
  lift b to ℝ≥0 using hb
  cases c
  · simp
  · norm_cast
    rw [tsub_tsub_tsub_cancel_left]
    exact mod_cast h

@[simp] lemma ofReal_iInf [Nonempty ι] (f : ι → ℝ) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (⨅ i, f i) = ⨅ i, ENNReal.ofReal (f i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ | h := em (∃ i, f i ≤ 0)
  · rw [iInf_eq_bot.2 fun _ _ ↦ ⟨i, by simpa [ofReal_of_nonpos hi]⟩]
    simp [Real.iInf_nonpos' ⟨i, hi⟩]
  replace h i : 0 ≤ f i := le_of_not_ge fun hi ↦ h ⟨i, hi⟩
  refine eq_of_forall_le_iff fun a ↦ ?_
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a ∞
  · simp
  rw [le_iInf_iff, le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le ha, le_ciInf_iff ⟨0, by simpa [mem_lowerBounds]⟩]
  · exact forall_congr' fun i ↦ (le_ofReal_iff_toReal_le ha (h _)).symm
  · exact Real.iInf_nonneg h

name: iInf_add

  simp [tsub_le_iff_right, add_comm]

proof:
:=
  suffices ⨅ a, f a + g a ≤ iInf f + iInf g from
    le_antisymm (le_iInf fun _ => add_le_add (iInf_le _ _) (iInf_le _ _)) this
  calc
    ⨅ a, f a + g a ≤ ⨅ (a) (a'), f a + g a' :=
      le_iInf₂ fun a a' => let ⟨k, h⟩ := h a a'; iInf_le_of_le k h
    _ = iInf f + iInf g := by simp_rw [iInf_add, add_iInf]

name: sub_iSup
statement: lemma sub_iSup [Nonempty ι] (ha : a ≠ ∞) : a - ⨆ i, f i = ⨅ i, a - f i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ | h := em (∃ i, a < f i)
  · rw [tsub_eq_zero_iff_le.2 <| le_iSup_of_le _ hi.le, iInf_eq_bot.2, bot_eq_zero]
    exact fun x hx ↦ ⟨i, by simpa [hi.le, tsub_eq_zero_of_le]⟩
  simp_rw [not_exists, not_lt] at h
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf fun i ↦ tsub_le_tsub_left (le_iSup ..) _) <|
    ENNReal.le_sub_of_add_le_left (ne_top_of_le_ne_top ha <| iSup_le h) <|
    add_le_of_le_tsub_right_of_le (iInf_le_of_le (Classical.arbitrary _) tsub_le_self) <|
    iSup_le fun i ↦ ?_
  rw [← sub_sub_cancel ha (h _)]
  exact tsub_le_tsub_left (iInf_le (a - f ·) i) _

name: ofReal_prod_of_nonneg
statement:
theorem ofReal_prod_of_nonneg {α : Type*} {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℝ} (hf : ∀ i, i ∈ s → 0 ≤ f i) :
    ENNReal.ofReal (∏ i ∈ s, f i) = ∏ i ∈ s, ENNReal.ofReal (f i)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ENNReal.ofReal, ← ofNNReal_finsetProd, coe_inj]
  exact Real.toNNReal_prod_of_nonneg hf

name: iInf_sum
statement:
theorem iInf_sum {ι α : Type*} {f : ι → α → ℝ≥0∞} {s : Finset α} [Nonempty ι]
    (h : ∀ (t : Finset α) (i j : ι), ∃ k, ∀ a ∈ t, f k a ≤ f i a ∧ f k a ≤ f j a) :
    ⨅ i, ∑ a ∈ s, f i a = ∑ a ∈ s, ⨅ i, f i a
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction_on with
  | empty => simp only [Finset.sum_empty, ciInf_const]
  | cons a s ha ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_cons, ← ih]
    refine (iInf_add_iInf fun i j => ?_).symm
    refine (h (Finset.cons a s ha) i j).imp fun k hk => ?_
    rw [Finset.forall_mem_cons] at hk
    exact add_le_add hk.1.1 (Finset.sum_le_sum fun a ha => (hk.2 a ha).2)

name: toNNReal_sum
statement:
theorem toNNReal_sum {s : Finset α} {f : α → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∀ a ∈ s, f a ≠ ∞) :
    ENNReal.toNNReal (∑ a ∈ s, f a) = ∑ a ∈ s, ENNReal.toNNReal (f a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← coe_inj, coe_toNNReal, ofNNReal_finsetSum, sum_congr rfl]
  · intro x hx
    exact (coe_toNNReal (hf x hx)).symm
  · exact sum_ne_top.2 hf

proof:

name: sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty {s : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty) {f g : α → ℝ≥0∞}
    (Hlt : ∀ i ∈ s, f i < g i) : ∑ i ∈ s, f i < ∑ i ∈ s, g i
proof:
:= by
  induction hs using Finset.Nonempty.cons_induction with
  | singleton => simp [Hlt _ (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)]
  | cons _ _ _ _ ih =>
    simp only [Finset.sum_cons, forall_mem_cons] at Hlt ⊢
    exact ENNReal.add_lt_add Hlt.1 (ih Hlt.2)

name: exists_le_of_sum_le
statement:
theorem exists_le_of_sum_le {s : Finset α} (hs : s.Nonempty) {f g : α → ℝ≥0∞}
    (Hle : ∑ i ∈ s, f i ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, g i) : ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≤ g i
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! Hle
  apply ENNReal.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty hs Hle

name: prod_inv_distrib
statement:
lemma prod_inv_distrib (hf : (s : Set ι).Pairwise fun i j ↦ f i ≠ 0 ∨ f j ≠ ∞) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i)⁻¹ = ∏ i ∈ s, (f i)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons i s hi ih => ?_
  simp only [Finset.prod_cons, ← ih (hf.mono <| by simp)]
  refine ENNReal.mul_inv (not_or_of_imp fun hi₀ ↦ prod_ne_top fun j hj ↦ ?_)
    (not_or_of_imp fun hi₀ ↦ Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.2 fun j hj ↦ ?_)
  · exact imp_iff_not_or.2 (hf (by simp) (by simp [hj]) <| .symm <| ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj hi) hi₀
  · exact imp_iff_not_or.2 (hf (by simp [hj]) (by simp) <| ne_of_mem_of_not_mem hj hi).symm hi₀

name: prod_div_distrib
statement:
lemma prod_div_distrib (hg : (s : Set ι).Pairwise fun i j ↦ g i ≠ 0 ∨ g j ≠ ∞) :
    (∏ i ∈ s, f i / g i) = (∏ i ∈ s, f i) / (∏ i ∈ s, g i)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, prod_inv_distrib hg, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]

name: finsetSum_iSup
proof:
:= by
  induction s using Finset.cons_induction with
  | empty => simp
  | cons a s ha ihs =>
    simp_rw [Finset.sum_cons, ihs]
    refine iSup_add_iSup fun i j ↦ (hf i j).imp fun k hk ↦ ?_
    gcongr
    exacts [(hk a).1, (hk _).2]

name: finsetSum_iSup_of_monotone
statement:
lemma finsetSum_iSup_of_monotone {α : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {s : Finset α}
    {f : α → ι → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∀ a, Monotone (f a)) : (∑ a ∈ s, iSup (f a)) = ⨆ n, ∑ a ∈ s, f a n
proof:
:=
  finsetSum_iSup fun i j ↦ (exists_ge_ge i j).imp fun _k ⟨hi, hj⟩ a ↦ ⟨hf a hi, hf a hj⟩

  | ⊤, n + 1 => by simp [top_pow]

name: mul_inv
statement:
protected theorem mul_inv {a b : ℝ≥0∞} (ha : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ ∞) (hb : a ≠ ∞ ∨ b ≠ 0) :
    (a * b)⁻¹ = a⁻¹ * b⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  case top =>
    simp_all only [Ne, not_true_eq_false, or_false, top_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, or_true,
      mul_top, inv_top, mul_zero]
  cases a
  case top =>
    simp_all only [Ne, top_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, coe_ne_top, or_self, not_true_eq_false,
      coe_eq_zero, false_or, top_mul, inv_top, zero_mul]
  grind [_=_ coe_mul, coe_zero, inv_zero, = mul_inv, coe_ne_top, ENNReal.inv_eq_zero,
    =_ coe_inv, zero_mul, = mul_eq_zero, mul_top, mul_zero, top_mul]

proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.inv_ne_zero] at htop
  rw [← ENNReal.inv_ne_top] at hzero
  rw [ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul, ENNReal.mul_inv htop hzero, mul_comm, inv_inv]

statement:
protected lemma div_div_cancel {a b : ℝ≥0∞} (h₀ : a ≠ 0) (h₁ : a ≠ ∞) :
    a / (a / b) = b

name: le_div_iff_mul_le
statement:
protected theorem le_div_iff_mul_le (h0 : b ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ 0) (ht : b ≠ ∞ ∨ c ≠ ∞) :
    a ≤ c / b ↔ a * b ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  cases b with
  | top =>
    lift c to ℝ≥0 using ht.neg_resolve_left rfl
    rw [div_top, nonpos_iff_eq_zero]
    rcases eq_or_ne a 0 with (rfl | ha) <;> simp [*]
  | coe b => ?_
  rcases eq_or_ne b 0 with (rfl | hb)
  · have hc : c ≠ 0 := h0.neg_resolve_left rfl
    simp [div_zero hc]
  · rw [← coe_ne_zero] at hb
    rw [← ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_left hb coe_ne_top, ENNReal.div_mul_cancel hb coe_ne_top]

name: div_le_iff_le_mul
statement:
protected theorem div_le_iff_le_mul (hb0 : b ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ ∞) (hbt : b ≠ ∞ ∨ c ≠ 0) :
    a / b ≤ c ↔ a ≤ c * b
proof:
:= by
  suffices a * b⁻¹ ≤ c ↔ a ≤ c / b⁻¹ by simpa [div_eq_mul_inv]
  refine (ENNReal.le_div_iff_mul_le ?_ ?_).symm <;> simpa

name: lt_div_iff_mul_lt
statement:
protected theorem lt_div_iff_mul_lt (hb0 : b ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ ∞) (hbt : b ≠ ∞ ∨ c ≠ 0) :
    c < a / b ↔ c * b < a

name: div_le_of_le_mul
statement: theorem div_le_of_le_mul (h : a ≤ b * c) : a / c ≤ b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : c = 0
  · have : a = 0 := by simpa [h0] using h
    simp [*]
  by_cases hinf : c = ∞; · simp [hinf]
  exact (ENNReal.div_le_iff_le_mul (Or.inl h0) (Or.inl hinf)).2 h

name: div_le_of_le_mul'
statement: theorem div_le_of_le_mul' (h : a ≤ b * c) : a / b ≤ c

name: exists_pos_mul_lt
statement: protected lemma exists_pos_mul_lt (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb₀ : b ≠ 0) : ∃ c, 0 < c ∧ c * a < b
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | hb := eq_or_ne b ∞
  · exact ⟨1, by simpa [lt_top_iff_ne_top]⟩
  refine ⟨b / (a + 1), ENNReal.div_pos hb₀ (by finiteness), ENNReal.mul_lt_of_lt_div ?_⟩
  gcongr
  exact ENNReal.lt_add_right ha one_ne_zero

name: inv_le_iff_le_mul
statement: theorem inv_le_iff_le_mul (h₁ : b = ∞ → a ≠ 0) (h₂ : a = ∞ → b ≠ 0) : a⁻¹ ≤ b ↔ 1 ≤ a * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← one_div, ENNReal.div_le_iff_le_mul, mul_comm]

name: le_inv_iff_mul_le

theorem le_inv_iff_mul_le : a ≤ b⁻¹ ↔ a * b ≤ 1
proof:
:= by

    · right
      simp

name: div_le_div
statement: @[gcongr] protected theorem div_le_div (hab : a ≤ b) (hdc : d ≤ c) : a / c ≤ b / d
proof:
:=
  div_eq_mul_inv b d ▸ div_eq_mul_inv a c ▸ mul_le_mul' hab (ENNReal.inv_le_inv.mpr hdc)

name: div_le_div_left
statement: protected theorem div_le_div_left (h : a ≤ b) (c : ℝ≥0∞) : c / b ≤ c / a

name: eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
statement: protected theorem eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (h : a * b = 1) : a = b⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_one a, ← ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel (right_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h), ← mul_assoc, h,
    one_mul]
  rintro rfl
  simp [left_ne_zero_of_mul_eq_one h] at h

name: mul_le_iff_le_inv
statement: theorem mul_le_iff_le_inv {a b r : ℝ≥0∞} (hr₀ : r ≠ 0) (hr₁ : r ≠ ∞) : r * a ≤ b ↔ a ≤ r⁻¹ * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← @ENNReal.mul_le_mul_iff_right _ a _ hr₀ hr₁, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel hr₀ hr₁,
    one_mul]

name: le_of_forall_nnreal_lt
statement: theorem le_of_forall_nnreal_lt {x y : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, ↑r < x → ↑r ≤ y) : x ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense fun r hr => ?_
  lift r to ℝ≥0 using ne_top_of_lt hr
  exact h r hr

name: eq_of_forall_nnreal_le_iff
statement: lemma eq_of_forall_nnreal_le_iff {x y : ℝ≥0∞} : (∀ r : ℝ≥0, ↑r ≤ x ↔ ↑r ≤ y) → x = y

name: eq_of_forall_le_nnreal_iff
statement: lemma eq_of_forall_le_nnreal_iff {x y : ℝ≥0∞} : (∀ r : ℝ≥0, x ≤ r ↔ y ≤ r) → x = y

name: le_of_forall_pos_nnreal_lt
statement: theorem le_of_forall_pos_nnreal_lt {x y : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, 0 < r → ↑r < x → ↑r ≤ y) : x ≤ y
proof:
:=
  le_of_forall_nnreal_lt fun r hr =>
    (eq_zero_or_pos r).elim (fun h => h ▸ zero_le) fun h0 => h r h0 hr

name: eq_top_of_forall_nnreal_le
statement: theorem eq_top_of_forall_nnreal_le {x : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ r : ℝ≥0, ↑r ≤ x) : x = ∞
proof:
:=
  top_unique <| le_of_forall_nnreal_lt fun r _ => h r

statement: protected theorem div_self (h0 : a ≠ 0) (hI : a ≠ ∞) : a / a = 1

name: mul_div_le
statement: theorem mul_div_le : a * (b / a) ≤ b

name: eq_div_iff
statement: theorem eq_div_iff (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a ≠ ∞) : b = c / a ↔ a * b = c
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [h, ENNReal.mul_div_cancel ha ha'], fun h => by
    rw [← h, mul_div_assoc, ENNReal.mul_div_cancel ha ha']⟩

name: div_eq_div_iff
statement:
protected theorem div_eq_div_iff (ha : a ≠ 0) (ha' : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hb' : b ≠ ∞) :
    c / b = d / a ↔ a * c = b * d
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff ha ha']
  conv_rhs => rw [eq_comm]
  rw [← eq_div_iff hb hb', mul_div_assoc, eq_comm]

name: div_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem div_eq_one_iff {a b : ℝ≥0∞} (hb₀ : b ≠ 0) (hb₁ : b ≠ ∞) : a / b = 1 ↔ a = b
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← (eq_div_iff hb₀ hb₁).mp h.symm, mul_one], fun h =>
    h.symm ▸ ENNReal.div_self hb₀ hb₁⟩

name: inv_two_add_inv_two
statement: theorem inv_two_add_inv_two : (2 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ + 2⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← two_mul, ← div_eq_mul_inv, ENNReal.div_self two_ne_zero ofNat_ne_top]

statement: theorem inv_three_add_inv_three : (3 : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ + 3⁻¹ + 3⁻¹ = 1
proof:
:= by

  ring

name: div_mul
statement:
protected lemma div_mul (a : ℝ≥0∞) (h0 : b ≠ 0 ∨ c ≠ 0) (htop : b ≠ ∞ ∨ c ≠ ∞) :

proof:
:= by
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  rw [ENNReal.mul_inv, inv_inv]
  · ring
  · simpa
  · simpa

proof:
:= by

statement: protected theorem half_pos (h : a ≠ 0) : 0 < a / 2

name: one_half_lt_one
statement: protected theorem one_half_lt_one : (2⁻¹ : ℝ≥0∞) < 1

name: half_lt_self
statement: protected theorem half_lt_self (hz : a ≠ 0) (ht : a ≠ ∞) : a / 2 < a
proof:
:= by
  lift a to ℝ≥0 using ht
  rw [coe_ne_zero] at hz
  rw [← coe_two, ← coe_div, coe_lt_coe]
  exacts [NNReal.half_lt_self hz, two_ne_zero' _]

name: exists_lt_mul_left
statement: private lemma exists_lt_mul_left {a b c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c < a * b) : ∃ a' < a, c < a' * b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a', hc, ha'⟩ := exists_between (ENNReal.div_lt_of_lt_mul hc)
  exact ⟨_, ha', (ENNReal.div_lt_iff (.inl <| by rintro rfl; simp at *)
    (.inr <| by rintro rfl; simp at *)).1 hc⟩

name: exists_lt_mul_right
statement: private lemma exists_lt_mul_right {a b c : ℝ≥0∞} (hc : c < a * b) : ∃ b' < b, c < a * b'
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [mul_comm a] at hc ⊢; exact exists_lt_mul_left hc

name: mul_le_of_forall_lt
statement: lemma mul_le_of_forall_lt {a b c : ℝ≥0∞} (h : ∀ a' < a, ∀ b' < b, a' * b' ≤ c) : a * b ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  refine le_of_forall_lt_imp_le_of_dense fun d hd ↦ ?_
  obtain ⟨a', ha', hd⟩ := exists_lt_mul_left hd
  obtain ⟨b', hb', hd⟩ := exists_lt_mul_right hd
  exact le_trans hd.le <| h _ ha' _ hb'

name: le_mul_of_forall_lt
statement:
lemma le_mul_of_forall_lt {a b c : ℝ≥0∞} (h₁ : a ≠ 0 ∨ b ≠ ∞) (h₂ : a ≠ ∞ ∨ b ≠ 0)
    (h : ∀ a' > a, ∀ b' > b, c ≤ a' * b') : c ≤ a * b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ENNReal.inv_le_inv, ENNReal.mul_inv h₁ h₂]
  exact mul_le_of_forall_lt fun a' ha' b' hb' ↦ ENNReal.le_inv_iff_le_inv.1 <|
    (h _ (ENNReal.lt_inv_iff_lt_inv.1 ha') _ (ENNReal.lt_inv_iff_lt_inv.1 hb')).trans_eq
    (ENNReal.mul_inv (Or.inr hb'.ne_top) (Or.inl ha'.ne_top)).symm

name: orderIsoIicOneBirational_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderIsoIicOneBirational_symm_apply (x : Iic (1 : ℝ≥0∞)) :

statement:
@[simp]
theorem orderIsoIicCoe_symm_apply_coe (a : ℝ≥0) (b : Iic a) :

theorem orderIsoUnitIntervalBirational_apply_coe (x : ℝ≥0∞) :

name: exists_inv_nat_lt
statement: theorem exists_inv_nat_lt {a : ℝ≥0∞} (h : a ≠ 0) : ∃ n : ℕ, (n : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ < a
proof:
:=
  inv_inv a ▸ by simp only [ENNReal.inv_lt_inv, ENNReal.exists_nat_gt (inv_ne_top.2 h)]

name: exists_nat_pos_mul_gt
statement: theorem exists_nat_pos_mul_gt (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ ∞) : ∃ n > 0, b < (n : ℕ) * a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨n, hn⟩ := ENNReal.exists_nat_gt (div_lt_top hb ha).ne
  ⟨n, Nat.cast_pos.1 hn.pos, by
    rwa [← ENNReal.div_lt_iff (Or.inl ha) (Or.inr hb)]⟩

name: exists_nat_mul_gt
statement: theorem exists_nat_mul_gt (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ ∞) : ∃ n : ℕ, b < n * a

name: exists_nat_pos_inv_mul_lt
statement:
theorem exists_nat_pos_inv_mul_lt (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    ∃ n > 0, ((n : ℕ) : ℝ≥0∞)⁻¹ * a < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_nat_pos_mul_gt hb ha with ⟨n, npos, hn⟩
  use n, npos
  rw [← ENNReal.div_eq_inv_mul]
  exact div_lt_of_lt_mul' hn

name: exists_nnreal_pos_mul_lt
statement: theorem exists_nnreal_pos_mul_lt (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ 0) : ∃ n > 0, ↑(n : ℝ≥0) * a < b
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_nat_pos_inv_mul_lt ha hb with ⟨n, npos : 0 < n, hn⟩
  use (n : ℝ≥0)⁻¹
  simp [*, npos.ne']

name: exists_inv_two_pow_lt
statement: theorem exists_inv_two_pow_lt (ha : a ≠ 0) : ∃ n : ℕ, 2⁻¹ ^ n < a
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_inv_nat_lt ha with ⟨n, hn⟩
  refine ⟨n, lt_trans ?_ hn⟩
  rw [← ENNReal.inv_pow, ENNReal.inv_lt_inv]
  norm_cast
  exact n.lt_two_pow_self

name: coe_zpow
statement:
@[simp, norm_cast]
theorem coe_zpow (hr : r ≠ 0) (n : ℤ) : (↑(r ^ n) : ℝ≥0∞) = (r : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with n | n
  · simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, coe_pow, zpow_natCast]
  · have : r ^ n.succ ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero (n + 1) hr
    simp only [zpow_negSucc, coe_inv this, coe_pow]

name: zero_zpow_def
statement: lemma zero_zpow_def (n : ℤ) : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n = if n = 0 then 1 else if 0 < n then 0 else ⊤
proof:
:= by
  obtain ((_ | n) | n) := n <;> simp [-Nat.cast_add, -Int.natCast_add]

name: top_zpow_def
statement: lemma top_zpow_def (n : ℤ) : (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n = if n = 0 then 1 else if 0 < n then ⊤ else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ((_ | n) | n) := n <;> simp [-Nat.cast_add, -Int.natCast_add]

name: zpow_pos
statement: theorem zpow_pos (ha : a ≠ 0) (h'a : a ≠ ∞) (n : ℤ) : 0 < a ^ n
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simpa using ENNReal.pow_pos ha.bot_lt _
  · simp only [h'a, pow_eq_top_iff, zpow_negSucc, Ne, ENNReal.inv_pos, false_and,
      not_false_eq_true]

name: zpow_lt_top
statement: theorem zpow_lt_top (ha : a ≠ 0) (h'a : a ≠ ∞) (n : ℤ) : a ^ n < ∞
proof:
:= by
  cases n
  · simpa using ENNReal.pow_lt_top h'a.lt_top
  · simp only [ENNReal.pow_pos ha.bot_lt, zpow_negSucc, inv_lt_top]

name: zpow_ne_top
statement: lemma zpow_ne_top {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha : a ≠ 0) (h'a : a ≠ ∞) (n : ℤ) : a ^ n ≠ ∞

name: exists_mem_Ico_zpow
statement:
theorem exists_mem_Ico_zpow {x y : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : x ≠ 0) (h'x : x ≠ ∞) (hy : 1 < y) (h'y : y ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, x ∈ Ico (y ^ n) (y ^ (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using h'x
  lift y to ℝ≥0 using h'y
  have A : y ≠ 0 := by simpa only [Ne, coe_eq_zero] using (zero_lt_one.trans hy).ne'
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h'n⟩ : ∃ n : ℤ, y ^ n ≤ x ∧ x < y ^ (n + 1) := by
    refine NNReal.exists_mem_Ico_zpow ?_ (one_lt_coe_iff.1 hy)
    simpa only [Ne, coe_eq_zero] using hx
  refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [← ENNReal.coe_zpow A, ENNReal.coe_le_coe]
  · rwa [← ENNReal.coe_zpow A, ENNReal.coe_lt_coe]

name: exists_mem_Ioc_zpow
statement:
theorem exists_mem_Ioc_zpow {x y : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : x ≠ 0) (h'x : x ≠ ∞) (hy : 1 < y) (h'y : y ≠ ⊤) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, x ∈ Ioc (y ^ n) (y ^ (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using h'x
  lift y to ℝ≥0 using h'y
  have A : y ≠ 0 := by simpa only [Ne, coe_eq_zero] using (zero_lt_one.trans hy).ne'
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h'n⟩ : ∃ n : ℤ, y ^ n < x ∧ x ≤ y ^ (n + 1) := by
    refine NNReal.exists_mem_Ioc_zpow ?_ (one_lt_coe_iff.1 hy)
    simpa only [Ne, coe_eq_zero] using hx
  refine ⟨n, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [← ENNReal.coe_zpow A, ENNReal.coe_lt_coe]
  · rwa [← ENNReal.coe_zpow A, ENNReal.coe_le_coe]

name: Ioo_zero_top_eq_iUnion_Ico_zpow
statement:
theorem Ioo_zero_top_eq_iUnion_Ico_zpow {y : ℝ≥0∞} (hy : 1 < y) (h'y : y ≠ ⊤) :
    Ioo (0 : ℝ≥0∞) (∞ : ℝ≥0∞) = ⋃ n : ℤ, Ico (y ^ n) (y ^ (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_Ioo, mem_Ico]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx, h'x⟩
    exact exists_mem_Ico_zpow hx.ne' h'x.ne hy h'y
  · rintro ⟨n, hn, h'n⟩
    constructor
    · apply lt_of_lt_of_le _ hn
      exact ENNReal.zpow_pos (zero_lt_one.trans hy).ne' h'y _
    · apply lt_trans h'n _
      exact ENNReal.zpow_lt_top (zero_lt_one.trans hy).ne' h'y _

name: zpow_le_of_le
statement:
@[gcongr]
theorem zpow_le_of_le {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : 1 ≤ x) {a b : ℤ} (h : a ≤ b) : x ^ a ≤ x ^ b
proof:
:= by
  obtain a | a := a <;> obtain b | b := b
  · simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    exact pow_right_mono₀ hx (Int.le_of_ofNat_le_ofNat h)
  · apply absurd h (not_le_of_gt _)
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (Int.negSucc_lt_zero _) (Int.natCast_nonneg _)
  · simp only [zpow_negSucc, Int.ofNat_eq_natCast, zpow_natCast]
    refine (ENNReal.inv_le_one.2 ?_).trans ?_ <;> exact one_le_pow_of_one_le' hx _
  · simp only [zpow_negSucc, ENNReal.inv_le_inv]
    apply pow_right_mono₀ hx
    simpa only [← Int.ofNat_le, neg_le_neg_iff, Int.natCast_add, Int.ofNat_one] using! h

name: monotone_zpow
statement: theorem monotone_zpow {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : 1 ≤ x) : Monotone ((x ^ ·) : ℤ → ℝ≥0∞)

name: zpow_add
statement:
protected theorem zpow_add {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : x ≠ 0) (h'x : x ≠ ∞) (m n : ℤ) :
    x ^ (m + n) = x ^ m * x ^ n
proof:
:= by
  lift x to ℝ≥0 using h'x
  replace hx : x ≠ 0 := by simpa only [Ne, coe_eq_zero] using hx
  simp only [← coe_zpow hx, zpow_add₀ hx, coe_mul]

name: zpow_neg
statement: protected theorem zpow_neg (x : ℝ≥0∞) (m : ℤ) : x ^ (-m) = (x ^ m)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  obtain hx₀ | hx₀ := eq_or_ne x 0
  · obtain hm | hm | hm := lt_trichotomy m 0 <;>
      simp_all [zero_zpow_def, ne_of_lt, ne_of_gt, lt_asymm]
  obtain hx | hx := eq_or_ne x ⊤
  · obtain hm | hm | hm := lt_trichotomy m 0 <;>
      simp_all [top_zpow_def, ne_of_lt, ne_of_gt, lt_asymm]
  exact ENNReal.eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left (by simp [← ENNReal.zpow_add hx₀ hx])

name: zpow_sub
statement:
protected theorem zpow_sub {x : ℝ≥0∞} (x_ne_zero : x ≠ 0) (x_ne_top : x ≠ ⊤) (m n : ℤ) :
    x ^ (m - n) = (x ^ m) * (x ^ n)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, ENNReal.zpow_add x_ne_zero x_ne_top, ENNReal.zpow_neg]

name: zpow_le_one_of_nonpos
statement: lemma zpow_le_one_of_nonpos {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≤ 0) {x : ℝ≥0∞} (hx : 1 ≤ x) : x ^ n ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := neg_surjective n
  lift m to ℕ using by simpa using hn
  rw [← ENNReal.inv_zpow', ENNReal.inv_zpow, ENNReal.inv_le_one]
  exact mod_cast one_le_pow₀ hx

name: isUnit_iff
statement: lemma isUnit_iff : IsUnit a ↔ a ≠ 0 ∧ a ≠ ∞
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ha ↦ ⟨ha.ne_zero, ?_⟩,
    fun ha ↦ ⟨⟨a, a⁻¹, ENNReal.mul_inv_cancel ha.1 ha.2, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel ha.1 ha.2⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := ha
  rintro hu
  have := congr($hu * u⁻¹)
  simp at this

name: mul_iSup
statement: lemma mul_iSup (a : ℝ≥0∞) (f : ι → ℝ≥0∞) : a * ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, a * f i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hf : ∀ i, f i = 0
  · simp [hf]
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a ∞
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := not_forall.1 hf
    simpa [iSup_eq_zero.not.2 hf, eq_comm (a := ⊤)]
      using le_iSup_of_le (f := fun i => ⊤ * f i) i (top_mul hi).ge
  · exact (mulLeftOrderIso _ <| isUnit_iff.2 ⟨ha₀, ha⟩).map_iSup _

name: mul_iInf'
statement:
lemma mul_iInf' (hinfty : a = ∞ → ⨅ i, f i = 0 → ∃ i, f i = 0) (h₀ : a = 0 → Nonempty ι) :
    a * ⨅ i, f i = ⨅ i, a * f i
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | ha₀ := eq_or_ne a 0
  · simp [h₀ rfl]
  obtain rfl | ha := eq_or_ne a ∞
  · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ | hf := em (∃ i, f i = 0)
    · rw [iInf_eq_bot.2, iInf_eq_bot.2, bot_eq_zero, mul_zero] <;>
        exact fun _ _ ↦ ⟨i, by simpa [hi]⟩
    · rw [top_mul (mt (hinfty rfl) hf), eq_comm, iInf_eq_top]
      exact fun i ↦ top_mul fun hi ↦ hf ⟨i, hi⟩
  · exact (mulLeftOrderIso _ <| isUnit_iff.2 ⟨ha₀, ha⟩).map_iInf _

statement:

proof: := by simpa only [mul_comm a] using mul_iInf' hinfty h₀

name: le_iInf_mul
statement:
lemma le_iInf_mul {ι : Type*} (u v : ι → ℝ≥0∞) :
    (⨅ i, u i) * ⨅ i, v i ≤ ⨅ i, u i * v i
proof:
:=
  le_iInf fun i ↦ mul_le_mul' (iInf_le u i) (iInf_le v i)

name: iSup_mul_le
statement:
lemma iSup_mul_le {ι : Type*} {u v : ι → ℝ≥0∞} :
    ⨆ i, u i * v i ≤ (⨆ i, u i) * ⨆ i, v i
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun i ↦ mul_le_mul' (le_iSup u i) (le_iSup v i)

name: le_iInf_mul_iInf
statement:
lemma le_iInf_mul_iInf {g : κ → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∃ i, f i ≠ ∞) (hg : ∃ j, g j ≠ ∞)
    (ha : ∀ i j, a ≤ f i * g j) : a ≤ (⨅ i, f i) * ⨅ j, g j
proof:
:= by
  rw [← iInf_ne_top_subtype]
  have := nonempty_subtype.2 hf
  have := hg.nonempty
  replace hg : ⨅ j, g j ≠ ∞ := by simpa using hg
  rw [iInf_mul fun h ↦ (hg h).elim, le_iInf_iff]
  rintro ⟨i, hi⟩
  simpa [mul_iInf fun h ↦ (hi h).elim] using ha i

name: iInf_mul_iInf
statement:
lemma iInf_mul_iInf {f g : ι → ℝ≥0∞} (hf : ∃ i, f i ≠ ∞) (hg : ∃ j, g j ≠ ∞)
    (h : ∀ i j, ∃ k, f k * g k ≤ f i * g j) : (⨅ i, f i) * ⨅ i, g i = ⨅ i, f i * g i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (le_iInf fun i ↦ mul_le_mul' (iInf_le ..) (iInf_le ..))
    (le_iInf_mul_iInf hf hg fun i j ↦ ?_)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := h i j
  exact iInf_le_of_le k hk

lemma smul_iSup {R} [SMul R ℝ≥0∞] [IsScalarTower R ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞] (f : ι → ℝ≥0∞) (c : R) :
    c • ⨆ i, f i = ⨆ i, c • f i
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← smul_one_mul c (f _), ← smul_one_mul c (iSup _), ENNReal.mul_iSup]

name: smul_sSup

lemma smul_sSup {R} [SMul R ℝ≥0∞] [IsScalarTower R ℝ≥0∞ ℝ≥0∞] (s : Set ℝ≥0∞) (c : R) :
    c • sSup s = ⨆ a ∈ s, c • a
proof:

name: trichotomy
statement:
protected theorem trichotomy₂ {p q : ℝ≥0∞} (hpq : p ≤ q) :
    p = 0 ∧ q = 0 ∨
      p = 0 ∧ q = ∞ ∨
        p = 0 ∧ 0 < q.toReal ∨
          p = ∞ ∧ q = ∞ ∨
            0 < p.toReal ∧ q = ∞ ∨ 0 < p.toReal ∧ 0 < q.toReal ∧ p.toReal ≤ q.toReal
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (bot_le : 0 ≤ p) with ((rfl : 0 = p) | (hp : 0 < p))
  · simpa using q.trichotomy
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (le_top : q ≤ ∞) with (rfl | hq)
  · simpa using p.trichotomy
  have hq' : 0 < q := lt_of_lt_of_le hp hpq
  have hp' : p < ∞ := lt_of_le_of_lt hpq hq
  simp [ENNReal.toReal_mono hq.ne hpq, ENNReal.toReal_pos_iff, hp, hp', hq', hq]

name: dichotomy

proof:

  haveI : p = ⊤ ∨ 0 < p.toReal ∧ 1 ≤ p.toReal := by
    simpa using ENNReal.trichotomy₂ (Fact.out : 1 ≤ p)
  this.imp_right fun h => h.2

name: toReal_pos_iff_ne_top
statement: theorem toReal_pos_iff_ne_top (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] : 0 < p.toReal ↔ p ≠ ∞

:=
  ⟨fun h hp =>
    have : (0 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := toReal_top ▸ (hp ▸ h.ne : 0 ≠ ∞.toReal)
    this rfl,
    fun h => zero_lt_one.trans_le (p.dichotomy.resolve_left h)⟩

proof:
:= by
  cases t
  · simp_rw [zero_eq_zero, sign_eq_zero_iff] at h ⊢
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero h
  · simp_rw [neg_eq_neg_one, sign_eq_neg_one_iff] at h ⊢
    exact Finset.sum_neg h hs
  · simp_rw [pos_eq_one, sign_eq_one_iff] at h ⊢
    exact Finset.sum_pos h hs

name: exists_signed_sum_aux
statement:
private theorem exists_signed_sum_aux [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℤ) :
    ∃ (β : Type u) (t : Finset β) (sgn : β → SignType) (g : β → α),
      (∀ b, g b ∈ s) ∧
        (#t = ∑ a ∈ s, (f a).natAbs) ∧
          ∀ a ∈ s, (∑ b ∈ t, if g b = a then (sgn b : ℤ) else 0) = f a
proof:
:= by
  refine
    ⟨(Σ _ : { x // x ∈ s }, ℕ), Finset.univ.sigma fun a => range (f a).natAbs,
      fun a => sign (f a.1), fun a => a.1, fun a => a.1.2, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [sum_attach (f := fun a => (f a).natAbs)]
  · intro x hx
    simp [sum_sigma, hx, ← Int.sign_eq_sign, Int.sign_mul_abs, mul_comm |f _|,
      sum_attach (s := s) (f := fun y => if y = x then f y else 0)]

name: exists_signed_sum
statement:
theorem exists_signed_sum [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℤ) :
    ∃ (β : Type u) (_ : Fintype β) (sgn : β → SignType) (g : β → α),
      (∀ b, g b ∈ s) ∧
        (Fintype.card β = ∑ a ∈ s, (f a).natAbs) ∧
          ∀ a ∈ s, (∑ b, if g b = a then (sgn b : ℤ) else 0) = f a
proof:
:=
  let ⟨β, t, sgn, g, hg, ht, hf⟩ := exists_signed_sum_aux s f
  ⟨t, inferInstance, fun b => sgn b, fun b => g b, fun b => hg b, by simp [ht], fun a ha =>
    (sum_attach t fun b ↦ ite (g b = a) (sgn b : ℤ) 0).trans <| hf _ ha⟩

name: exists_signed_sum'
statement:
theorem exists_signed_sum' [Nonempty α] [DecidableEq α] (s : Finset α) (f : α → ℤ)
    (n : ℕ) (h : (∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natAbs) ≤ n) :
    ∃ (β : Type u) (_ : Fintype β) (sgn : β → SignType) (g : β → α),
      (∀ b, g b ∉ s → sgn b = 0) ∧
        Fintype.card β = n ∧ ∀ a ∈ s, (∑ i, if g i = a then (sgn i : ℤ) else 0) = f a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, _, sgn, g, hg, hβ, hf⟩ := exists_signed_sum s f
  refine
    ⟨β ⊕ (Fin (n - ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).natAbs)), inferInstance, Sum.elim sgn 0,
      Sum.elim g (Classical.arbitrary (Fin (n - Finset.sum s fun i => Int.natAbs (f i)) → α)),
        ?_, by simp [hβ, h], fun a ha => by simp [hf _ ha]⟩
  rintro (b | b) hb
  · cases hb (hg _)
  · rfl

name: zero_eq_zero

name: map_cast'
statement:
lemma map_cast' {β : Type*} [One β] [Neg β] [Zero β]
    (f : α → β) (h₁ : f 1 = 1) (h₂ : f 0 = 0) (h₃ : f (-1) = -1) (s : SignType) :
    f s = s
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> simp only [SignType.cast, h₁, h₂, h₃]

    f s = s

name: sign_apply
statement: theorem sign_apply : sign a = ite (0 < a) 1 (ite (a < 0) (-1) 0)

name: sign_zero
statement:

statement:
@[simp]
theorem sign_pos (ha : 0 < a) : sign a = 1

name: sign_neg
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sign_neg (ha : a < 0) : sign a = -1
proof:
:= by
  rwa [sign_apply, ite_eq_right <| asymm ha, ite_eq_left]

name: sign_eq_one_iff
statement: theorem sign_eq_one_iff : sign a = 1 ↔ 0 < a
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => sign_pos h⟩
  by_contra hn
  rw [sign_apply, ite_eq_right hn] at h
  split_ifs at h

name: sign_eq_neg_one_iff
statement: theorem sign_eq_neg_one_iff : sign a = -1 ↔ a < 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => sign_neg h⟩
  rw [sign_apply] at h
  split_ifs at h
  assumption

name: StrictMono.sign_comp
statement:
lemma StrictMono.sign_comp {β F : Type*} [Zero β] [Preorder β] [DecidableLT β]
    [FunLike F α β] [ZeroHomClass F α β] {f : F} (hf : StrictMono f) (a : α) :
    sign (f a) = sign a
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sign_apply, ← map_zero f, hf.lt_iff_lt]

name: sign_eq_zero_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sign_eq_zero_iff : sign a = 0 ↔ a = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h.symm ▸ sign_zero⟩
  rw [sign_apply] at h
  split_ifs at h with h_1 h_2
  cases h
  exact (le_of_not_gt h_1).eq_of_not_lt h_2

name: sign_nonneg_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sign_nonneg_iff : 0 ≤ sign a ↔ 0 ≤ a
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy 0 a with (h | h | h)
  · simp [h, h.le]
  · simp [← h]
  · simp [h, h.not_ge]

name: sign_nonpos_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sign_nonpos_iff : sign a ≤ 0 ↔ a ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy 0 a with (h | h | h)
  · simp [h, h.not_ge]
  · simp [← h]
  · simp [h, h.le]

name: sign_eq_sign_or_eq_neg
statement:
lemma sign_eq_sign_or_eq_neg {b : α} (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) :
    sign a = sign b ∨ sign a = -sign b
proof:
:= by
  rcases trichotomy (sign a) with hsa | hsa | hsa <;>
    rcases trichotomy (sign b) with hsb | hsb | hsb <;>
    simp_all

name: Left.sign_neg
statement: theorem Left.sign_neg [AddLeftStrictMono α] (a : α) : sign (-a) = -sign a
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [sign_apply, Left.neg_pos_iff, Left.neg_neg_iff]
  split_ifs with h h'
  · exact False.elim (lt_asymm h h')
  · simp
  · simp
  · simp
